body: Never build SQL by concatenating a table-name constant ("CREATE TABLE " + TableNameX, "REFERENCES " + ...). Every table name goes through the Auth (a.TableName(t), the renaming dialect), because auth.RenameTable and auth.WithTablePrefix rename tables per instance. TestGuard_TableNamesNeverConcatenated enforces it, and task check reruns the integration suite with every table prefixed.
